evidence_note: One entry per reused capability actually called by the pattern module. `poc_command` is the real command that exercises the dependency through the adapter; `poc_result_ref` is the test node id plus the numbers measured in this workspace. No entry claims a capability that is not called in code.

entries.requirement: Fixed-radius Poisson disk sampling on the mother chart with a periodic seam (plan 9.4)
candidates: scipy.stats.qmc.PoissonDisk (native l_bounds/u_bounds, radius in mm, optimization=None)
poisson_disk_sampling / Bridson reference implementations (rejected: would require re-implementing the active-list kernel)
entries.selected_dependency: scipy (scipy.stats.qmc.PoissonDisk) + scipy.spatial.cKDTree for the periodic extension
entries.poc_result_ref: tests/a12/patterns/test_patterns_reuse_poc.py::test_poc_scipy_poisson_periodic_extension ; measured: n_candidates=48, n_kept=46, cross-seam removals=2, rejection_rate=0.0417, min periodic neighbour distance=5.5106 mm vs required 5.5 mm, density=2.130/100mm2 vs target 1.336/100mm2, max gap=7.423 mm
entries.gap_reason: The library samples a plain rectangle and does not model the chart seam or variable radii, so the extension adds wrapped copies (x +/- C_ref), a stable-order rejection pass and the variable-radius condition d_ij >= r_i + r_j + clearance.
entries.custom_scope: Periodic-seam rejection order, variable-radius retention rule, audit metrics (rejection rate, density, largest gap). No sampling kernel is rewritten.

entries.requirement: Nearest-neighbour / cross-seam distance queries on the frozen dot set
entries.poc_result_ref: tests/a12/patterns/test_patterns_poisson.py::test_poisson_cross_seam_minimum_distance_small_mother ; measured: periodic min neighbour distance 4.515 mm >= 2r = 4.0 mm, radius-sum margin +0.515 mm, cross-seam min 5.71 mm
entries.custom_scope: None beyond passing the periodic copies into the index.

entries.requirement: Analytic arc length, Bezier/Arc segments and bounded flattening for waves, meanders, leaves and symbols (plan 9.5)
candidates: manual Bezier evaluation (rejected: generic Bezier solver is on the forbidden list)
entries.poc_result_ref: tests/a12/patterns/test_patterns_reuse_poc.py::test_poc_svgpathtools_arc_length_and_flattening ; measured: library length 62.83185307179586 mm vs analytic 2*pi*10 mm (relative error < 1e-15), flattened with 68 points, achieved chord error 0.0107 mm <= 0.05 mm requested, flattened length 62.8066 mm
entries.gap_reason: svgpathtools exposes point/length but no bounded flattening policy, so the adapter adds adaptive bisection with an explicit chord-error budget and measures the achieved error.
entries.custom_scope: Adaptive bisection driven by library point() calls, arc-length resampling, leaf placement along the arc length. No Bezier/Arc maths is re-implemented.

entries.requirement: Text layout frozen once per recipe with a millimetre-accurate raster distance map (plan 9.5)
entries.license_ref: MIT-CMU (Pillow), BSD-3-Clause (SciPy); font: Apache-2.0 (Roboto, bundled with open3d 0.20.0)
entries.poc_result_ref: tests/a12/patterns/test_patterns_reuse_poc.py::test_poc_pillow_layout_and_scipy_distance_transform ; measured: font roboto_medium sha256:4ac8e036..., EDT max error 0.125 mm = one 0.125 mm texel against an analytic disc, run pitch 26.667 mm over 3 copies with tile_wrap_exact=True, raster plan px_per_mm=8.0 and period_exact=True
entries.gap_reason: Pillow has no letter-spacing API and no periodic tiling, so the adapter advances per glyph with Pillow advance widths and snaps the run pitch to an exact divisor of the tile width.
entries.custom_scope: One-shot layout bookkeeping, periodic tile wrap, per-glyph advance from Pillow metrics, EDT scale validation. No font parsing or kerning tables.

entries.requirement: Legal SVG path input and 2-D closed-outline fill geometry (plan 9.5 PAT11)
candidates: xml.etree.ElementTree for the restricted SVG subset
entries.selected_dependency: svgpathtools 1.8 (path data) + Shapely 2.1 (fill geometry) + stdlib XML parser (element allow-list)
entries.poc_result_ref: tests/a12/patterns/test_patterns_reuse_poc.py::test_poc_shapely_fill_geometry ; measured: rosette ring polygon area 3.1365 mm2 vs analytic pi (0.16% error), all 7 outlines valid, vectorised containment true at the centre and false 10 mm away. Loader rejections verified in tests/a12/patterns/test_patterns_resources.py (script, external reference, DOCTYPE entity, oversize, missing file).
entries.gap_reason: Neither library validates an SVG document, so the adapter keeps a documented element/attribute allow-list and caps file size, element count and segment count; the path data itself is parsed by svgpathtools.
entries.custom_scope: Restricted SVG validation, programmatic symbol construction from library primitives, symbol scaling/placement. No SVG renderer and no path-data parser.

entries.requirement: One-shot rasterisation of chart-aligned motifs with exact periodic sampling and a millimetre distance layer
entries.poc_result_ref: tests/a12/patterns/test_patterns_helpers.py::test_raster_tile_wraps_exactly ; measured: sample(x=0) is bit-identical with sample(x=C_ref) for the distance and colour layers, width_px/px_per_mm == C_ref exactly (period_exact=True); seam audit error 0.0 for all 16 families (tests/a12/patterns/test_patterns_seam.py)
entries.gap_reason: The libraries do not know about the chart period, so the adapter draws wrapped copies, snaps the pixel scale so that an integer number of columns spans exactly one period and pads the EDT border by the stored distance range.
entries.custom_scope: Chart-to-pixel mapping, wrap bookkeeping, EDT border and quantisation policy, frozen PNG payload. No resampling or distance kernel is written.

entries.requirement: Periodic random Fourier fields with integer azimuthal counts, de-meaned and RMS-normalised on area-weighted mother samples (plan 9.2)
candidates: numpy FFT/ufuncs for the transform and the band energy
Perlin/fBm replacement field (rejected: not strictly band-limited)
entries.poc_result_ref: tests/a12/patterns/test_patterns_helpers.py::test_fourier_basis_integer_azimuthal_counts_close_exactly and ::test_measured_spectrum_recovers_a_known_wavelength ; measured: u=0 and u=1 values bit-identical, band amplitudes 1.0/0.5/0.25, a synthetic 10-cycle cosine is recovered as 12.00 mm with >50% of the energy in its octave band
entries.gap_reason: numpy has no notion of the vessel chart, so the adapter fixes integer azimuthal counts, the octave band structure and the area-weighted normalisation.
entries.custom_scope: Chart-aware basis sampling, per-band energy measurement, warp Jacobian report. FFT and surface sampling stay library calls.

entries.requirement: Real relief / engraving by displacing the complete mother body, with refinement or refusal when the mesh cannot represent the frozen wavelengths (plan 9.1 step 5, 9.3 PAT14/15)
candidates: trimesh ray casting for the wall-thickness guard
entries.poc_result_ref: tests/a12/patterns/test_patterns_geometry.py ; measured: PAT15 volume delta -98.46 mm3 with 0.6 mm depth and 0 flipped faces (watertight preserved), PAT14 ratio-guarded relief adds material, appearance-only families return the identical object and unchanged geometry hash, a 2.0 mm groove on a 1.6 mm wall is rejected with TARGET_INFEASIBLE
entries.gap_reason: A closed swept tool for engraving is not implemented; the module applies real vertex displacement instead and records `boolean_tool_route: NOT_IMPLEMENTED` plus the measured interpolation error, so the precision claim stays checkable.
entries.custom_scope: Displacement sampling on the chart, wall-thickness guard, refinement policy, precision measurement. Mesh subdivision and ray casting stay library calls.
